Party.title: Party
Party.description: A customer or supplier account in the shop register tracking credit given, payments/credit received, and net balance.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated shop owner.

name.description: Full name or business name of the customer or supplier.

phone.description: Optional phone number for contact or reminders.

role.description: Classification of the party in the shop register.

notes.description: Additional notes, address, or credit terms for this party.

totalGivenCents.description: Total amount in cents that the shop gave or sold on credit to this party.

totalGotCents.description: Total amount in cents that the shop received or bought on credit from this party.

netBalanceCents.description: Net balance in cents (totalGivenCents - totalGotCents). Positive means party owes the shop; negative means shop owes the party.

entryCount.description: Total count of transaction entries recorded for this party.

lastActivitySummary.description: Short summary of the most recent transaction entry.

dueDateMillis.description: Optional due date timestamp in epoch milliseconds for settlement reminder (0 if unset).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the party record was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the party record was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

LedgerEntry.title: LedgerEntry
LedgerEntry.description: An individual credit or payment transaction entry associated with a party in the shop register.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated shop owner.

partyId.description: The document ID of the Party this entry belongs to.

partyName.description: Denormalized name of the Party for display in global register views.

type.description: GAVE means shop gave money/goods on credit (they owe us); GOT means shop received money/goods on credit (we owe them).

amountCents.description: Transaction amount in cents (must be positive).

description.description: Detailed itemization or note for the transaction entry.

category.description: Category label such as Goods Sold, Cash Received, Stock Purchase, Bill Payment, or Advance.

paymentMode.description: Payment or credit instrument used for this entry.

referenceNote.description: Optional invoice, bill, or receipt reference number.

entryDateMillis.description: Transaction date and time in epoch milliseconds.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/parties/{partyId}.description: Stores customer and supplier accounts owned by a specific user.

/users/{userId}/entries/{entryId}.description: Stores detailed transaction ledger entries for parties owned by a specific user.
